flows.title: From request to delivery
flows.description: A process can be mapped without any screens. Connect people, decisions, and external handoffs with the same viewer.

nodes.title: Request received
nodes.description: Operations checks the delivery address and confirms the requested items.

nodes.title: Ready to ship
nodes.description: The warehouse packs the order and records the parcel weight.

nodes.title: Carrier handoff
nodes.description: A delivery partner accepts the parcel. This step happens outside the product.

nodes.title: Delivery confirmed
nodes.description: The recipient confirms delivery. Operations closes the request.

nodes.title: Wait for replenishment
nodes.description: Purchasing requests the missing stock and notifies operations when it arrives.
